(Kṣṭṣ vol. no. 74)
(kaśmirasaṃskṛtagranthāvali)
(granthāṅka � 74 )
(parātrīśikātātparyadīpikā)
(somānandakṛtaṃ śāktavijñānam ca)
(śrīrājarājeśvara-mahārājādhirāja-kaśmīranarendra) (śrīharisiṃhajī-bahādurājñayā)
(risarcakāryālayādhyakṣa � ) (paṇḍita jagaddhara jāḍūśāstriṇā) (kāryālayasthetarasaṃpādakapaṇḍitasahāyena) (saṃśodhanādisaṃskaraṇottaraṃ saṃpādya)
(śrīnagare nārmalapresa mudraṇālaye mudrāpayitvā ) (prākāśyamupanīte)
(kaśmīra-śrīnagara)
(saṃvat 2004) (īsvī 1947)
{śrīparātrīśikātātparyadīpikā} |
vande kundendunīhāravalakṣaṃ vighnahāriṇam | haragaurīsamārabdhaṃ herambaṃ hastipuṅgavam || 1 ||
akalaṅkaśaśāṅkābhā tryakṣā candrakalāvatī | mudrāpustalasadvāhā pātu vaḥ paramā kalā || 2 ||
śrīmatkailāsakaśmīrakāśīvyāghrapurīsthitam | trikārthadarśinaṃ vande devaṃ somāṃśabhūṣaṇam || 3 ||
yaiḥ sarvaśiṣyairācāryaiḥ pratyakṣaparameśvaraiḥ | vyākhyātaṃ triśikākhyaṃ yacchrīśāsanamanuttaram || 4 ||
taddarśitadiśā tasya padyairvyākhyodayatyasau | tātparyaprathanārthatvāttejorūpāḥ pramākṛtaḥ || 5 ||
tadapekṣātmasadbhāvāḥ tamaḥkalpāḥ pramābhuvaḥ | upakrāntyavalambaitadudayātmatayoditāḥ || 6 ||
tejastamomayātmīyasadbhāvā mānarāśayaḥ | yatra sṛṣṭitayā bhānti labhante tat tadātmatām || 7 ||
hṛdayatvena bhāntyete tyaktatattatprathāvidhāḥ | tadekarasatāṃ yātāḥ tadātmatvena bhāntyalam || 8 ||
tadetatsatataṃ tyaktapārokṣyaṃ sannidhiṃ śrayan | samanyūnādhikatvena yasya kasyāpyabhāvataḥ || 9 ||
anuttaraṃ cidekātmajyotirvandanarūpayā | stutyābhivādarūpātma tadanyonyātmatātmanā || 10 ||
sphurāmi tanmayatvena śāśvatena samāviśan | viśrāntiḥ pūrṇarūpeyaṃ nibaddhaivamupakrame || 11 ||
viśrāntayoṃśagāstvante nibhetsyante kṛtāviha | śāsanairmālinīsiddhāpramukhaiḥ śāsitā śivaḥ || 12 ||
mandamadhyamarūpāṇāmaucityenādhikāriṇām | aprabuddhamatīnāṃ hi etā bālavibhīṣikāḥ || 13 ||
mātṛmodakavatsarvaṃ pravṛttyarthamudāhṛtam | iti vijñānacinnāthapratipāditayā diśā || 14 ||
uttarottaratatttādṛgbhūmikārohahetave | ativistṛtatattādṛgdīkṣācaryādiḍambaraiḥ || 15 ||
trikaṃ prakāśayāmāsa naraśaktiśivātmakam | aparādimayatvena prastutenāgamena tu || 16 ||
anuttareṇa tanmātṛmānameyātmakaṃ trikam | anuttaraṃ svakīyaṃ taddhṛdayaṃ viśvatatparam || 17 ||
śrīmadutpaladevīyaṃ śāstraṃ stotrapadātmakam | pratyabhijñānamātrodyadbhairavībhāvavaibhavam || 18 ||
kathayāmi na sandehaḥ sadyaḥ kaulikasiddhidam | hṛdayaṃ devadevasya sadyo yogavimokṣadam || 19 ||
adṛṣṭamaṇḍalo'pyevaṃ tilājyāhutivarjitam | ityevamādirūpeṇa mune śreṣṭhakamātmanaḥ || 20 ||
prakāśayati tadvyākhyā nirmāṇāpyeṣa tasya ye | prasaṃhaprāvikānyoktatattadīkṣābhivistarām || 21 ||
vyākhyāṃ vitenire teṣāmapahāya dṛśisthitim | śrīmadutpaladevīyamatasāratayā param || 22 ||
vyākhyāṃ karoti viśadāmevaṃ meyādikaṃ trikam | vimarśasārameveha siddhyupāyatayā matam || 23 ||
abhidheyatayā tasya viṣayatvena darśitam |
śeṣadvayam(,)
anavacchinnanānātmamāheśvaravimarśatām || 24 ||
avāptaṃ śāsanamidamanidaṃ dhīpadodayam | tathāvidhena bhāvena sadāhantvena siddhimat || 25 ||
1prakāśāmarśarūpatvādata eva hyanuttaram | anuttarasya devasya hṛdayaṃ svollasattayā || 26 ||
pratnatatpratibodhaitadupasaṃhārarūpayā | svātaṃtryātsvata evaivaṃ sphūrjatyasyāyamāśayaḥ || 27 ||
parāparavibhūtyāptirūpo mantratayodyatām | vidyātmanāṃ vimarśānāmityantasyātmahṛdbhuvaḥ || 28 ||
prasṛtasyāgamasyaiva parasaṃbandharūpatā | devāddevyā samāyātaṃ tasyāstārakavairiṇaḥ || 29 ||
ityādiguruvaryātmakramāvāptisvarūpakam | saṃbandhamanapekṣyaivaṃ svatantrā budhyatāmiti || 30 ||
tṛtīyasya devyuvācetyupakrāntasya devatām | gatasya bhairavetyādimadhyasyaivaṃ phalodayaḥ || 31 ||
śeṣaḥ |
vyākhyātṛto'pi hṛdayaṃ vyākhyaiṣā tanmayatvataḥ | tadvadeva svasaṃvittisamullāsatayoktayā || 32 ||
sphūrjatyanuttaraṃ kṛtvā natu śiṣyādyapekṣayā | evaṃ pravṛttau vyākhyāturdevasyecchaiva codikā || 33 ||
<-----------------------------------> (1prakāśatvānurūpatvāt - ityapi pāṭhaḥ |)
hariṇā yatra yaccoktaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyatā | devasyānuttaraṃ hṛttat sphūrjati svayamityataḥ || 34 ||
anuttaraṃ kathaṃ deva sadyaḥ kaulikasiddhidam | ityupakramarūpasya praśnasyāsya vinirṇaye || 35 ||
hṛdayaṃ devadevasya sadyo yogavimokṣadam | ityupakramaśāstrasya yāvatpūrti yaducyate || 36 ||
viśvāvabhāsakāritvaṃ siddhidvitayadāyikā | hṛdayasya kathaṃ tasya vacanasyātra saṃgatiḥ || 37 ||
bhavediti nirāsāya śaṃkāyā avadhāryatām | saṃbandho maulikaḥ so'yaṃ darśitaḥ phalatastu saḥ || 38 ||
devenāgamarūpeṇa svenāgre darśayiṣyate | khecarīsamatāṃ yena vrajedityādinā sphuṭam || 39 ||
vyācikhyāsitarūpasya śāsanasya yadātmanā | vyākhyayā saṃvidhānasya sāmānyena kuto vidhiḥ || 40 ||
kasya saṃgrahatastāvat tātparyaṃ pratipādyate | śāsanasyādime śloke sā śeṣe'nuttareśituḥ || 41 ||
devasya (......................) kena syāt vedyāditritayātmanā | prakāreṇa yato jñātā saṃvidaḥ pūrṇaśaktitaḥ || 42 ||
prakāreṇa ca kenāsya siddhidvitayadāyitā | iti praśne darśayitvā vastvetaṃ prastutātmakam || 43 ||
bodhayātman prabhāvākhyā prabandheneti vṛttikṛt | samastamupacikṣepa śāstrasyārthaṃ dvitīyake || 44 ||
seyaṃ svātaṃtryaśaktyātmā svaparāmarśavigrahā | hṛdi sarvasya bhātyeva prakriyeti ca taṃ punaḥ || 45 ||
praśnaṃ śithilayitvātha praśno'yaṃ siddhyavāptaye | sā tasyāḥ pratyabhijñānalābhena prakriyātmanaḥ || 46 ||
śaktiṃ vinā na bhavatītyevaṃ tadupayogitā | praśnasyāsyopapādyātha tṛtīye śaktimīritām || 47 ||
prastāvya kathanīyeti kauliko'yaṃ vidhirmama | hṛdaye hṛdayatvena cāste'sau viditastadā || 48 ||
iti śeṣeṇa caucityaṃ tasya vakturadarśayat | kathanaṃ cottarārambhapūrvāvasthāpradarśanāt || 49 ||
pravartayaṃścatuṣke tu tāṃ parāditrikātmikām | śaktiṃ pañcāśatā varṇaiḥ prasarantīṃ pradarśayan || 50 ||
śeṣeṇa cāpyamūleti jñeyaiṣetyevamūcivān | aṣṭame tu tathā tasyā avibhāgātmanā sthitiḥ || 51 ||
sāraṃ pradarśya navame tadātmīkāramātrataḥ | sūcitāṃ prathame sūtre siddhiṃ prādarśayat parām || 52 ||
athāṣṭake tvatītādipraharocitayā vidhiḥ | iti śeṣatrayopekṣe (te) śāsanāntaracoditām || 53 ||
prāṇādijayakālādi niyamātmatayoditām | vidyāvratādirūpāñca mantrārpaṇavidhocitām || 54 ||
saṃkucattāṃ vinā saṃvitparāmarśasya saṃpade | parā api prasiddhyanti siddhayo'syāptireva tu || 55 ||
etanmantragrahe sādhyetyetatsamyaṅnyarūpayat | catuṣke'thāṣṭamaślokaproktasya hṛdayātmanaḥ || 56 ||
bījasya viśvābhinnāyāḥ śaktisaṃpūrtilakṣmaṇaḥ | parāyāḥ svātmasaṃvittervimarśatvaṃ nyarūpayat || 57 ||
tadvācyavācakābhedābhyāsatatphalalakṣaṇam | uktvā dvāviṃśake sūtre navamaślokasūcitam || 58 ||
phalaṃ prākaṭyamanayat upasaṃhāravartmanā | atha traye tadabhyāse pūrvabhāvitayodyate || 59 ||
saparyāvidhaye bhedarūpiṇyā vighnasaṃhṛteḥ | sāmānyato viśeṣācca śāntiṃ sandarśya talpare || 60 ||
caturdaśābhijaptenetyupakrāntyaṃśasaṃyute | (........)ṭathā pūjyarūpaniṣkarṣapūrvakam || 61 ||
yāgahomobhayātmatvaṃ pūjāyāḥ pūrtilakṣaṇam | upapādya ca sarveṣāṃ abhyāsānāṃ phalātmanām || 62 ||
pūjāpuraḥsaratvaṃ yattat samarthitavānatha | triṃśe tu yānyānityaṃśasahite proktalakṣaṇaḥ || 63 ||
tasyābhyāsacatuṣkasya saṃvidāmarśanātmanaḥ | saphalasya sphuṭenaiva svarūpeṇopadarśanam || 64 ||
prathayitvā tathāṃśasya caturyāmamayaṃ dinam | yāvadabhyasya tatsiddhiṃ yoginaḥ pratyavādayat || 65 ||
upāntyetvasya śāstrasya samarthyārthopasaṃhṛtim | saprabhāvaṃ parāmṛśya (..................................) || 66 ||
prādarśayadayaṃ tāvattattātparyasya saṃgrahaḥ | athāvayavaśo vyākhyā tasyedānīṃ vilikhyate || 67 ||
śeṣaḥ |
guruśiṣyapde sthitvā svayaṃ devaḥ sadāśivaḥ | pūrvottarapadairvākyaistantraṃ samavatārayan || 68 ||
iti svacchandadevoktasvasaṃvitsiddhavartmanā | prabudhyamānā svātmaiva devatā pratyagātmanaḥ || 69 ||
satī pratyabhijijñāsurātmanāṃ pṛcchatīśvaram | tatra śrīdevyuvāceti kṛtaḥ śrīśāsanodayaḥ || 70 ||
samanantarasūtrasya kathaṃkārānurūpyataḥ | asya dhātorvaceratra praśnārthatvena yojanā || 71 ||
tadgatāya tu bhūtatvaṃ pārokṣyañcāsya nirvacaḥ | bhaviṣyatyucite paścāt pratipatṛnirūpaṇe || 72 ||
kiṃpṛcchatītyapekṣāyāṃ jātāyāmāha śāsanam |
śeṣam (-)
anuttaraṃ kathaṃ deva sadyaḥ kaulikasiddhidam || 73 ||
yena vijñātamātreṇa khecarīsamatāṃ vrajet | etadguhyaṃ mahāguhyaṃ kathayasva mama prabho || 74 ||
he deveti samastārthajīvatātman maheśvara | jñāne kriyāyāṃ sarvatra jñātṛtākartṛtātmanā || 75 ||
ātmanaivādisiddhatvātprāthamyābhimukhatvabhāk | tvaṃ tavānuttaraṃ rūpamuttarān grāhakān mitān || 76 ||
grāhyasāpekṣasadbhāvājjaḍāddehāditarpitān | anyadeva svayaṃ bhānaṃ mādikālādikalpanam || 77 ||
anapahnavanīyena jāgartyaniśamātmanā | tatra vāco'vakāśo no dūre vācyaniyojanāḥ || 78 ||
atastatpraśnaviṣayaḥ kasya cetayiturbhavet |
śeṣaḥ
idaṃ tu pṛcchatyetasya tayā prakriyayātmanaḥ || 79 ||
dehākṣabhuvanādyātmakulasaṃpattirūpatā | bhāsate svāmyapūrṇatvasvatantratvānivāritā || 80 ||
etayā jñātayā kiṃ syāditi ceducyate'nayā1 | jñānagocaratāpannamātrayā vyomni cinmaye || 81 ||
carantī saṃvideṣā syātpūrṇaśaktitvataḥ svataḥ | kṛtārthapratyabhijñātādanyathā naiva khecarī || 82 ||
vedyabhūmiṣu saṃcārādata eva na pūrṇatā | vedyairniyantritātmīyacārāyāḥ saṃvido mahaḥ || 83 ||
śeṣaḥ |
tayā vā jñātamātreṇa devatābhiḥ samatvadam | rūpaṃ saṃvinmayaṃ tatte kulasaṃbandhinīṃ parām || 84 ||
jīvan bhairavatāmarśasudhāsvādotsavātmikām | aparāṃ ca tathā siddhiṃ viśvātmatvodayātmikām || 85 ||
svasaṃviddevatācakracakravarttitvacinmayīm | dadāti dhāraṇādyātmakriyāyāḥ sānapekṣitam || 86 ||
yadetatprastutaṃ vastu dvayamaprakaṭaṃ svataḥ | na māyīyena kenāpi śaktyāsya prakaṭā kriyā || 87 ||
upādeyatamatvena bhāti cotkarṣavattayā | svayameva yathā bhāti tathākṛtvāsya gopateḥ || 88 ||
prabhuḥ prakaṭane ca tvaṃ mama tvat kḷptasaṃsthiteḥ | tvanniyuktatayaivaivaṃ pṛcchantyāḥ saṃvidastava || 89 ||
kathanena vimarśasya paśyantyādikramodayām | vaikharīvṛttiparyantāṃ padavīmānaya prabho || 90 ||
na tu ca grāhakatvātmā hṛdaye sā prakāśate |
<----------------------------------> (1adhunetyapi pāṭhaḥ |)
sarvasya tasya praśnena kiṃ syāt satyaṃ prakāśate || 91 ||
prakāśamānāpyeṣā tu svabhāvena yathā tathā | hṛdayaṅgamatāṃ naiti pathi parṇatṛṇādivat || 92 ||
natvaprakāśamānatvaṃ svato no cettathāstu sā | tadānīṃ ko bhavaddoṣo naitat saṃsaraṇaṃ param || 93 ||
tadetadrāghavāyoktaṃ vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā |
śeṣaḥ |
svāparāmarśamātro'yamaparādhaḥ kiyānasau || 94 ||
tāvanmātreṇa tajjātaṃ yadvaktuṃ naiva pāryate | pratyabhijñā mayāpūrvacamatkārarasātmani || 95 ||
hṛdayaṅgamatāyāṃ gīḥ satyāṃ pūrvoktalakṣaṇā | purā tadā tadabhyāsasādhyāpyapararūpiṇī || 96 ||
dvividhāpi bhavet tṛptiḥ siddhirūpā navānyathā | iti prathayitavyāṃśaprathanāyopayogavān || 97 ||
praśnastadarthametasmāduttaraḥ śāsanodayaḥ | hṛdaye yā tu sā śaktiḥ kaulikī kulanāyikā || 98 ||
tāṃ me kathaya deveśa yena tṛptiṃ vrajāmyaham | svayaṃ saṃvinmaye tatra tvadrūpe'nuttare hṛdi || 99 ||
tadātmatvena viśrāntā yāsau svātaṃtryalakṣaṇā | śaktirdhātvartharūpatvātsarvadhātvarthadharmiṇī || 100 ||
sphurattā vāṅmayī varṇapañcāśaktiśarīriṇī | varṇatrayāvibhāgātmabījabhāvavyavasthitā || 101 ||
yasyāḥ kulamidaṃ grāhyagrahaṇagrāhakātmakam | cakraṃ nirmeyatāṃ labdhvā sattāmāpnoti śāśvatīm || 102 ||
nirmitasya kulasyāsya nāyikā tasya vedanāt | tadbhātaṃ kurvatī yā ca tadadhiṣṭhātṛtāpadam || 103 ||
tadīyarūpa (re śanti) viyoganayanakriyā (?) | netrī ca mamatāmenāṃ hṛdayaṃgamatāṃ naya || 104 ||
hṛdayaṃgamatānītyā yayā prastutarūpayā | svātmalābhātmanā labdhatadabhyāsātmanā tathā || 105 ||
ahaṃ sarvārthasaṃvittimayī pūrṇāśayā satī | tṛptī dve prastute prāpya tvayi peye cidambudhau || 106 ||
śeṣaḥ |
evamudyantṛtā śaktisvarūpānupraveśanaiḥ | prabuddhatā syāt pūrṇatvātsaiṣā bhairavarūpiṇī || 107 ||
svātmaiva devatā praṣṝprativaktṛtvamaśnute |
śeṣaḥ |
praśnakṛtprativaktṛtvaprathārūpe'tra vastuni || 108 ||
idānīmidametādṛgiheti vyavahāragā | vyavahārapadānāṃ yā vastunāmāditeṣyate || 109 ||
yaiṣā na vāstavī tadvatsvarūpamanidaṃpratham | anujjhadeva kālena svaklaptakalanātmanā || 110 ||
bhinnenāvartate yasmād bhūtatvenocyate tataḥ | tathāvedyatayāpyetadbhāti kalpitarūpayā || 111 ||
pratyakṣagrāhyatābhāvāt parokṣeṇocyate tataḥ | tataḥ śrībhairavo deva uvācetīdamucyate || 112 ||
śeṣaḥ |
śṛṇu devi mahābhāge uttarasyāpyanuttaram |
kauliko'yaṃ vidhirdevi mama hṛdvyomnyavasthitaḥ || 113 ||
kathayāmi na sandehaḥ sadyaḥ kaulikasiddhidam | śrutiḥ kathanasāpekṣā kathanaṃ jñānapūrvakam || 114 ||
atastadānuguṇyena yojyate'rdhatrayaṃ tvidam | ityevamuttaratrāpi tatra tatra bhaviṣyati || 115 ||
śeṣaḥ |
prabodhodayaparyāptamahābhāgyaśarīrīṇi | śrutvāvadhāryatāṃ saiṣā yatastāmuttarāṃ tava || 116 ||
grāhakatvamayīṃ grāhyagrahaṇagrāhakātmakām | anuttarāṃ parāṃ śaktimuktatṛptiprayojanām || 117 ||
hṛdayaṅgamatāmenāṃ tathā devi nayāmi te | yathāvadhāraṇe jātamātra evātra vastuni || 118 ||
na punaḥ saṃśayānantaproktamālinyamajjanam | yato mama prabuddhasya hṛdaye mātṛkātmikā || 119 ||
śabdarāśistayā prāptabhairavībhāvasaṃpadaḥ | hṛdayatvena cāste'sau viditā bījarūpiṇī || 120 ||
athādyāstithayaḥ sarve svarā bindvavasānakāḥ (gāḥ) | tadantaḥ kālayogena somasūryau prakīrtitau || 121 ||
pṛthivyādīni tattvāni puruṣāntāni pañcasu | kramātkādiṣu vargeṣu makārānteṣu suvrate || 122 ||
vāyvagnisalilendrāṇāṃ dhāraṇānāṃ catuṣṭayam | tadūrdhvaṃ śādi vikhyātaṃ purastādbrahmapañcakam || 123 ||
amūlā tatkramājjñeyā kṣāntā sṛṣṭirudāhṛtā | sarveṣāmeva mantrāṇāṃ vidyānāṃ ca yaśasvini || 124 ||
iyaṃ yoniḥ samākhyātā sarvatantreṣu sarvadā | hṛdvyomnītyatra saptamyā hṛdayātsaṃvidātmanaḥ || 125 ||
anutpādatayā siddhiḥ prasiddhā keyamiṣyate | kaulikasya vidhereṣa iti pratyakṣarūpatā || 126 ||
sarvasya kathamityeṣā tryaṃśikā nātra yujyate | jñeyajñānāgrahe jñātustadrase svamayatvataḥ || 127 ||
tadbhāvena svataivaikā kadācidbhātyasāviti | jānāmi ghaṭamityātmaviśrāntirjñeyarūpiṇī || 128 ||
kadācitsvāminaivaikā kālayorubhayorapi | padārthadvitayaṃ tatra saṃvidi prathate yataḥ || 129 ||
śeṣaḥ |
tatra jñātā ca sarvātmanirvivādā parokṣabhāk | jñeyonmeṣanimeṣātma-svakriyā-kalanātmanā || 130 ||
tatsaṃkocavikāsātmanā(...........................................) | nityena vibhunā jñānakriyānirvṛtilakṣaṇā || 131 ||
svena bhāvena paritaḥ svasyāhamidamātmatā | spandanenaiva sāreṇa prasidhyati na jātucit || 132 ||
pariniṣṭhitarūpatvaṃ paricchinnaṃ prakāśatām | jaḍānāmātmasākurvanneti loṣṭhātitulyatām || 133 ||
kāṇādasāṃkhyabauddhādimitadṛkkalpitāmasau | saṃsṛtau guṇinaṃ tatra kaṇabhugdarśanāśritāḥ || 134 ||
apavarge taducchede manyante taṃ śilopamam | arthaprakāśakaṃ jñānaṃ bauddhameveti niścitāḥ || 135 ||
kāpilā api taṃ prāhurarthādenamasatsamam | dhīvṛttirnirvimarśātmā kṣaṇikātmeti saugatāḥ || 136 ||
svayamevopayāntyenaṃ śūnyameva vipaścitaḥ | nirvimarśakriyaṃ bhānaṃ viśvātmatvena taṃ pare || 137 ||
abhyupetyāsya sadbhāvaṃ māyāvedāntiśābdikāḥ | avidyāndhatvatanmuktyoraviśiṣṭaṃ viviñcate || 138 ||
anye'pi caivamanyoktasvoktadūṣaṇabhūṣaṇe | vitanvānāstvayītyuktarūpamenamupāsate || 139 ||
jñeyasattāprathārūpajñātṛkartṛtvalakṣaṇaḥ | jñātaiṣa svaparispandasāratveneha niścitaḥ || 140 ||
sā saṃkocavikāsātmā tasya ca spandatikriyā | bāhyāntarātmavyāptyanyamayadvaividhyayoginī || 141 ||
viśvabījātmahṛdayā tadaṃśeṣu yathā yathā | uccāraṇamuhūrtādisamāveśātmanā diśā || 142 ||
jñāteṣu sphuṭatāmeti jñātṛtāsya tathā tathā | utkṛṣyate pare yāvattattve bhairavasaṃjñini || 143 ||
uccāraṇe'pi prāṇātmaspandanātmanyasanmukhī | yathā yathā sā nyūnatvamajñāteṣvaśnute tathā || 144 ||
tathā nikṛṣyate yāvajjaḍe pāṣāṇaparvaṇi |
śeṣaḥ |
sa cāyaṃ mama saṃkocavikāsavapurātmanaḥ || 145 ||
anuttarasya śaktiḥ sā visargātmaivamātmanaḥ | prakāśaikatanuryasmātseyaṃ jñānakriyātmikā || 146 ||
anuttarasya me śaktirvisargātmāttarūpiṇī | aḥ ityatrāta evaiṣa sadviśrāntyudayātmanoḥ || 147 ||
śivo viśvādyanantāntaḥ paraṃ śaktitrayaṃ matam | ityetaddarśitātmīyalakṣmaṇoḥ bhairavātmanoḥ || 148 ||
śivaśaktyościdvimarśaparipūrtisvarūpayoḥ | saṃghaṭṭa ucyate rudrayoginīyāmalātmanā || 149 ||
sā ca svāntarabhedena bhavadbhiḥ sārvakālikaiḥ | cidānandaiṣaṇeśitvasonmeṣonatvaśaktibhiḥ || 150 ||
iccheśanacidantaḥsthacetyasattāsphurānvitaiḥ | cidānandaguṇībhūtavṛddhīcchonmeṣamiśraṇaiḥ || 151 ||
caturbhireṣaṇājñānakriyātatsamatātmabhiḥ | vedyasaṃskāravittyātmabindusaṃvedanānvitaiḥ || 152 ||
viśeṣaistithiḥsaṃkhyātaiḥ pūryamāṇāvatiṣṭhate | evaṃ pūrṇavisargātmā yaścidātmā visargataḥ || 153 ||
parabhairavabhairavyoryāmalaṃ tadvisargatā | teṣu sāmānyarūpatvānna pṛthaktvena gaṇyate || 154 ||
śeṣaḥ |
evaṃ visargarūpe me hṛdaye'nuttarātmanaḥ | vakturvaktikriyārūpe tādātmyena sthitā satī || 155 ||
prasaratyevameṣā yadakārādyā amantimāḥ | ete prabodhacandrasya prakāśāhlādarūpiṇaḥ || 156 ||
sthitervisargarūpāyāḥ pūraṇāttithisaṃjñinaḥ | svarāśca śabdanātmānaḥ svaparāmarśavigrahāḥ || 157 ||
svayañca svaprakāśārthaprakāśatvena rājanam | kurvate sarva evaite yattātparyavasānabhūḥ || 158 ||
somasūryātmasaṃkocavikāsaspandanātmakaḥ | adha ūrdhvavibhāgodyad bindudvitayavigrahaḥ || 159 ||
kālena kalanārūpaparāmarśātmatātmanā | aviyuktatayā bhāti tithīnāṃ kālatājuṣām || 160 ||
teṣāmātmā visargācca bhūtvā prasarati svayam |
śeṣaḥ |
eṣaiva bahirapyāttasomasūryātmatātmanām || 161 ||
tithīnāṃ kālatābhājāṃ yāti naktaṃdivātmatām | pareyaṃ sā visṛṣṭiḥ syāttadiccheśanavartinaḥ || 162 ||
vedyasya bahirunmeṣe sthūlasūkṣmatvabhedataḥ | pṛthvyambvagnyānilavyomasaṃjñā yattattvapañcakam || 163 ||
gandharūparasasparśaśabdanātma ca pañcakam | sa eva vedyasyollāsaḥ spṛśyate karaṇātmanā || 164 ||
yadā tadendriyāṇāṃ syātkarma jñānātmanāṃ prathā | daśadhodeti vāgādyā prāṇādyā tattvarūpiṇī || 165 ||
tataḥ krameṇa vedyatvanyagbhāve vedanodgame | mano'haṃkaraṇaṃ buddhiḥ pradhānaṃ pañcamaḥ pumān || 166 ||
iti tattvāni jāyante pañca vedyāni tāni ca | nanu puṃso vedakasya vedyeṣu gaṇanaṃ katham || 167 ||
ucyate'sya mitatvena puṃso vedyeṣu kīrtanam | tenānena vinā kasya vedyaṃ pṛthvyādi tadbhavet || 168 ||
uktakramaṃ śivo vetti yataḥ sarvaṃ tadakramam | ahamityātmaviśrāntaṃ mameti tu na jātucit || 169 ||
yasmāttena vinā vedyaṃ na syāt tat pṛthivīmukham | tadvedyābhāsanasyeyadrūpaṃ yadvedyatājuṣaḥ || 170 ||
dehādervedyajātasya bhinnaṃ vedyaṃ pratisvataḥ | vedakī bhāvanā tatra kriyāyāṃ vyāvṛtā imāḥ || 171 ||
kiṃcitkartṛtayā tasya prerikā vāyavī kalā | vidyā kiṃciñjñatṛtāsya vāhnī tasya prakāśikā || 172 ||
abhiṣvaṅganimagnatvastambhanavyāvṛtisphurā | pārthivī rāgaśaktistaccatuṣkātmā niyāmikā || 173 ||
niyatistasya kāryeṣu tāścatasro hi śaktayaḥ | vedyavettrātmanorvittyormadhye viśramayantritam || 174 ||
rodasyorantare yadvat triśaṅkumuniśaktayaḥ | anyathedaṃprathaikatvādasau loṣṭhāditāṃ vrajet || 175 ||
ahaṃsaṃvedanaikatve pūrṇaṃ citkhaṃ samutpatet | prakāradvitaye'pyasya māyāmāturabhāvataḥ || 176 ||
akiṃcanatve vedyasya pṛthvyāderapi tattvataḥ | saṃkoco vā vikāso vā na bhavedvāstavastadā || 177 ||
anyonyāśrayabhāvena tayorekātmatā yataḥ | tadvisargasvarūpeṇa saṃkucadvikasattayā || 178 ||
aśeṣamiyadākṣiptaṃ yadgrāhyagrāhakātmakam | anyonyaucityataḥ sṛṣṭiḥ padārthānāṃ pratāyate || 179 ||
śeṣaḥ |
vyomaśaktistvakāyātmā nātra vyāpriyate vidhau | avedyatvācca vedyānāmavakāśatvataśca tat || 180 ||
pramātṛtā paraṃ siddhyai tayā śuddhā svayaṃprathā |
śeṣaḥ |
evamārabhya pṛthivīṃ māyāntā tattvavistṛtiḥ || 181 ||
kādimāntaparāmarśarūpeyamaparocyate | vedyatāyāḥ krameṇāsya nyagbhāve saṃvidātmanaḥ || 182 ||
prakāśane ca rūpasya prathate tattvapañcakam | kañcukonmocanārūpavikāsabrahmanātmakam || 183 ||
taddhṛtyāpyāyanālokaspandanavyāpanakriyam | sadvidyeśvarasādākhyaśaktisaṃvitsvarūpakam || 184 ||
sadyādīśānaparyantabrahmatvenāpi viśrutam | kakārādikṣakārāntaparāmarśaśarīrakam || 185 ||
tadātmā prasṛtistasyā vācaḥ soktā parāparā | evaṃ visargarūpatvaṃ prāptāttasmādanuttarāt || 186 ||
prasṛtaṃ tadvisargasya rūpaṃ saṃvitkriyātmakam | anuttarā yā prasṛtirhāntā viśvasvarūpiṇī || 187 ||
pratyāhṛtāśeṣaviśvānuttare sā vilīyate | tadidaṃ viśvamantasthaṃ śaktau sānuttare pare || 188 ||
tattasyāmiti yatsatyaṃ vibhunā saṃpuṭīkṛtiḥ | visarga eva śākto'yaṃ śivabindutayā punaḥ || 189 ||
garbhīkṛtānantaviśvaḥ śrūyate'nuttarātmatā | iti niścitayā nītyā tasminnātmanyanuttare || 190 ||
pratyāhṛtaitadvarṇaughaparāmarśaprathātmakam | punaḥ prarohaṇaucityamayabījātmabindutām || 191 ||
prāptaṃ tathāvisargatvanisargaṃ pratipadya ca | viśramya vapurapyevaṃ prasṛtiṃ pratipadyate || 192 ||
yato mamaitacchaktīnāṃ cakramicchānuvartanam | cidānandaiṣaṇājñānakriyāṇāṃ bhāvayātmanām || 193 ||
bhūtakañcukabījatvamaucityenāśritātmanām | anuttarecchonmeṣātmatryaśraviśramitātmakam || 194 ||
tathāhyanuttarā tatra citsyādicchā tridhodyatām | iṣyamāṇārthasadbhāvā mīlanonmīlatattvabhāk || 195 ||
ānandaḥ prathamāṃśena madhyenecchāntimena sā | jñānamunmeṣaśaktiḥ syāt kriyātastat trayātmakam || 196 ||
avibhāgaparāmarśarūpaṃ prathamatastataḥ | vibhāgāmarśavapuṣā pañca tadbhedamāgatam || 197 ||
parāmṛśyātmanā bāhyatattvajālañca jāyate | parāmarśātmatā tasya jīvitaṃ tasya mātṛkā || 198 ||
utpattibhumistatsaiva mantrāṇāṃ guptabhāṣiṇām | catuṣkalanavātmādibījapiṇḍatayodyatām || 199 ||
puṃrūpavācyādhyāsena bhātāṃ vidyātmanāmapi | namaḥ śaṃbhava ityādisphuṭavedyārthavācinām || 200 ||
strīrūpavācyādhyāsena bhātāṃ māyātmanāmapi | sarveṣāṃ kāraṇatvena cocyate (....................................) || 201 ||
tathāhi sarvatantreṣu yatkiṃcittattvamiṣyate | parāparavibhūtyāptiparatṛptipradāyakam || 202 ||
tatsarvaṃ labhate tattvaṣaṭtriṃśatyāntarātmani | vimarśajīvitatvena tasyāḥ sarvavimarśabhūḥ || 203 ||
sarvaṃ dadāti sā devī mātṛkā tattadātmikā |
śeṣaḥ |
eṣoktā trividhā sṛṣṭirādikṣāntākṣarātmikā || 204 ||
anuttarāccidākāśādakṣarādasvarātmanaḥ | prasṛtā kānta tattvaughā punarviśramaṇonmukhī || 205 ||
pratyāhṛtasamastaitadvācyavācakacinmayī | tatraivānuttare dhāmni kramaṇaṃ bhajate śive || 206 ||
tava jñeyatayedānīmātmanodāhṛtā mayā | anayā jñātayaivaṃ hi tvayā jñātamanuttaram || 207 ||
akhaṇḍapūrṇaparacitprakāśaspandanātmakam | sahajāhaṃparāmarśaśaktisaṃbhāvitākhilam || 208 ||
vitatya vyaktamevaitadahamanyattatopi yat | iti kṣayaiva jñātaṃ syādata evaṃ yaśasvinī || 209 ||
iyadviśvaśarīrāsi tvamityuddhoṣyase budhaiḥ | iyaṃ kiloktavibhavā tattattvamiti niścayaḥ || 210 ||
tadevamavibhāgātmā sthitā pūrvaṃ hṛdambare | śaktirvimarśarūpā sā vibhāgāmarśarūpataḥ || 211 ||
samastatattvasadbhāvamayī kaulikasiddhidā | anenaivoktarūpeṇānuttarasya mamātmanaḥ || 212 ||
svātaṃtryeṇa visargo'sau svīkarotīti niścitam | nanvete santi bhedātmaparāmarśamayodayāḥ || 213 ||
kramādādyāḥ kṣakārāntāstadabhedamayodayāḥ | prastutā vāṅmayī śaktiryeyaṃ bhairavatāmayī || 214 ||
yato bījādudetyeṣā hṛdayāttava śāśvatāt | tatprāptasarvasaṃpattisaṃprāptyamṛtasāgare || 215 ||
hṛdayasya svarūpe te niścayābhāvalakṣaṇaḥ | saṃśayo'dyāpi nopaiti cyavanaṃ manaso mama || 216 ||
tatkartavyamidānīmityetadāśaṃkya śāsanam | taṃ cyāvayati sūtreṇa pareṇa parameśituḥ || 217 ||
caturdaśayutaṃ bhadre tithīśāntasamanvitam | tṛtīyaṃ brahma suśroṇi hṛdayaṃ bhairavātmanaḥ || 218 ||
saṃpūrṇānuttarānandasaṃvitsaṃpattiśālinā | kriyādvārāntarānītavāñcchājñānadvayaśriyā || 219 ||
aśeṣasaṃvitsaṃghaṭṭaparāmarśamayātmanā | caturdaśena yadidaṃ svareṇa sahitaṃ tadā || 220 ||
tṛtīyaṃ brahma sādākhyatattvātmāghorabhāsanam | ahantāntaḥkṛtedantārupagrāhyārthalakṣaṇam || 221 ||
tadviśvaṃ tattithīśānāṃ svarāṇāmuktalakṣaṇam | paryantabhittibhūto'sau ya ātmatvena niścitaḥ || 222 ||
visargastatra viśrāmyadaviyogena vartate | tadidaṃ hṛdayaṃ śabdarāśeḥ cidbharitātmanaḥ || 223 ||
sarvatattvamayaḥ kāyastaṃ cedānīṃ śṛṇu priye | pṛthivī kaṭhinatvena dravatveṃ'bhaḥ prakīrtitam || 224 ||
ityādi triśirodeva(sthityā)strityāyupapannayā (?) | tattvaistatasya dehasya tantritasya tvagādibhiḥ || 225 ||
sādhubhirbhinnasandhānaistadaśeṣabhidojjhitam | tatsattāsaṃvidātmatvaṃ satattvaṃ satatoditam || 226 ||
hṛdayaṃ padyaterarthatayā yadvadapekṣyate | evamevātmanaḥ śambhoḥ śabdarāśeḥ śarīriṇaḥ || 227 ||
vibhaktatattvabhūtādiprathāsaṃtānatantritam | parāmarśamayatvena pañcāśadvarṇatātmakam || 228 ||
viśvaṃ śarīraṃ yadidaṃ tadaśeṣabhidojjhitam | tatsattā saṃvidātmatvaṃ satattvaṃ satatoditam || 229 ||
hṛdayaṃ viśramasthānaṃ saccidānandalakṣaṇam | he viśrāntimayāhlādavimarśamayavigrahe (!) || 230 ||
suśroṇi yadidaṃ proktaṃ śaktitritayasaṃkucat | vikasatvamayasvātmatryaśraspandanasundaram || 231 ||
tadviddhi hṛdayaṃ tasya śabdarāśitanormama | parāyā ātmabhūtāyāḥ parāmarśatanościteḥ || 232 ||
etaduktaṃ bhavatyeṣā māmasau saṃvidadvayā | etena tāvatspandena proktabījātmanā dvayoḥ || 233 ||
koṭyorudayaviśrāntitattvayoḥ spandate tathā | tatprabhāvata evārthaprakāśāmarśanātmani || 234 ||
svātmabhairavasaṃvittau visargātmani vakṣyate | turyaparyantarūpāyāḥ kṣepo viśvavyavasthiteḥ || 235 ||
etannāyoginījāto nārudro labhate sphuṭam | hṛdayaṃ devadevasya sadyo yogavimokṣadam || 236 ||
viśvasya bījametadyo labhate puṇyakṛtpumān | tadaivaṃ na paśuḥ so'yaṃ labdhe'sminnetadeva hi || 237 ||
jāyate hṛdayaṃ tasya saitaddhṛdayataiva yat | bhairavatvaṃ tato rudrayoginīyāmalātmanoḥ || 238 ||
svātmabhairavabhairavyoḥ svato'nyonyāviyuktayoḥ | svarūponmīlanātmātmavīryapānakriyodyatām || 239 ||
dāmpatyājjāta evāsau na labhetaitadanyathā | asmin hyunmīlite'nena hṛdayena sahaikatā || 240 ||
etaddhṛdayalābhaśca sa evoktasvarūpayoḥ | dampatyoryāmalāveśā miṣattadbhāvalakṣaṇaḥ || 241 ||
evamunmīlane jātamātre rūpamanuttaram | yathā dadāti tatsiddhiṃ jīvanmuktimayīṃ parām || 242 ||
tathā nirṇītamadhunā yathā tadaparā api | kulasaṃbandhinī siddhiḥ tyaktānyāyāsaḍambaram || 243 ||
svātmasaṃvitparāmarśabalādeva dadātyamum | prakāraṃ prakaṭīkartuṃ śāsanopakramaḥ param || 244 ||
asyoccāre kṛte samyaṅmantramudrāgaṇo mahān | sadyastanmukhatāmeti svadehāveśalakṣaṇam || 245 ||
etatsaṃvitsvasattvaṃ ceddhṛdayatvaṃ prapadyate | tadā syājjivato muktiḥ parā siddhiritīritam || 246 ||
yathā tadeva prāṇādibhūmiṣvābhāsasaṃpadā | tadrūpajāḍyamālinyasamunmūlanatattvayā || 247 ||
rasadhātuvaduktaitadrūpatāpādanātmanā | prasaradrūpatāmeti tadāsyā devasaṃvidaḥ || 248 ||
nāḍījayādiśāstroktayogasāpekṣatojjhitāḥ | tatsamāveśaparyāyāḥ prasarātsaṃpado'khilāḥ || 249 ||
aparā api jāyanta iti tātparyavarṇanā | asyetyamuta ārabhya jāyate yajanaṃ prati || 250 ||
iti paryavasānasya śāsanāṃśasya vistṛteḥ | athāsya bījasyoccāre vakṣyamāṇena vartmanā || 251 ||
taduccārayitustasya tadudyogakriyātmani | prāṇātmatāyāṃ jāte tu samāveśapurodite || 252 ||
jñānakriyāśarīrāyā mantramudrāmahaujasaḥ | vidyante gaṇanātītavibhavā gaṇaśaḥ sthitāḥ || 253 ||
ābhimukhyaṃ bhajantyetāḥ svadehāveśataḥ katham | saṃpūrṇe vitkriyātmoktahṛdayaikātmatājuṣā || 254 ||
prāṇenādhiṣṭhitenāhantādvāreṇa tadātmakam | avaśyaṃ kampaghūrṇyādividhāyinyo bhavanti tāḥ || 255 ||
mantramudrāgaṇāveśo jāto yaḥ prāṇadehayoḥ | ayaṃ tāvadvibhūtīnāmupakramatayocyate || 256 ||
tadā yatnatayā tāsāṃ tā hi tatsiddhisādhane | devatātvena tadvīryarūpatvena ca sannidhim || 257 ||
kurvāṇāḥ sādhakasyāsya sādhayanti samīhitam | muhūrtaṃ smarate yastu cumbakenābhimudritaḥ || 258 ||
sa badhnāti tadā dehe mantramudrāgaṇaṃ mahat | atītānāgatānarthānpṛṣṭo'sau kathayatyapi || 259 ||
tathāvidhaṃ samāveśaṃ yadi nāḍīdvayāvadhim | abhyasyati mukhaṃ kurvankākacañcupuṭākṛti || 260 ||
bahiścocchiṣṭabhāvaughabhakṣaṇodyogabhāvitaḥ | sadvṛttirūpasomātmaśītasparśodayāvadhiḥ || 261 ||
uccaran hṛdayaṃ pītaviyaccarasamīraṇaḥ | prāṇena sparśarūpeṇa proktenaikatvamānayan || 262 ||
nābhisthānasthitasvātmavaiśvānarahutāśaniḥ | tajjvālātmakriyārūpāṃ tatprītaṣṭāṃ samācaran || 263 ||
apārajaladhiprakhyāmāśrayan kāmapi sthitim | āste yadā tadā dehe vāgrūpe kāyalakṣaṇe || 264 ||
mantramudrāgaṇāveśamavaśatvena paśyati | praṣṭaśca prativaktyeṣa vastu kālatrayoditam || 265 ||
tadgrāsātprāptatadbhāvadhiṣaṇādattabimbitam | praharādyadabhipretaṃ devatārūpamuccaran || 266 ||
sākṣāt paśyatyasandigdhamākṛṣṭaṃ rudraśaktibhiḥ | praharadvayamātreṇa vyomastho jāyate smaran || 267 ||
avaitathyena jātāyāṃ siddhau tatkathanātmani | apyanujjhitapūrvoktatādṛśābhyāsakauśalaḥ || 268 ||
kāṃcinmantramayīṃ mudrāmayīṃ vā devatāṃ smaran | āste cedyāmaparyantakālagrāsātmacitkriyaḥ || 269 ||
tadānīṃ tadavaṣṭambhasāmarthyāpāditātmatām | tāmeva devatāṃ tattadveṣabhūṣādilakṣitām || 270 ||
adhyakṣayatyasandigdhaṃ nijāhaṃsaṃvidātmikām | punarapyevamevemamabhyāsamaparityajan || 271 ||
yāvaddhṛdayamāste'sau tadekātmā yadā tadā | dehādikaṃ na kiṃcitsvamāvṛtitvena paśyati || 272 ||
anāvaraṇacidvyomarūpaṃ sarvamapīkṣate | trayeṇa mātaraḥ sarvā yogīśvaryo mahābalāḥ || 273 ||
vīrā vīreśvarāḥ siddhāḥ balavān śākinīgaṇaḥ | āgatya samayaṃ dattvā bhairaveṇa pracoditāḥ || 274 ||
yacchanti paramāṃ siddhiṃ phalaṃ yadvā samīhitam | svenānyadehakaṃ yena dehenānena bhāvite || 275 ||
sarvātmanā kṣayaṃ yāte svasyāvacchedane sati | punarapyanavacchinnasvasamāveśapuṣkalaḥ || 276 ||
yāmatritayamāste ca tadetaccāsya noditāḥ | brāhmyādyā mātarastattāmāptā yogīśvarīgaṇāḥ || 277 ||
tripūrvaśāstranirdiṣṭā vīrā vīreśvarāśca ye | aghoramukhyāḥ śrīmanto napeśādyāstadīśvarāḥ (?) || 278 ||

bhuktimuktyubhayāsvāde svaciccakrānujīvane | kartreṣitṛjñātṛmayasvaprathāmarśanātmani || 284 ||
vimarśanasvarūpasya visargātmanyanuttare | ānandakevalātmīyaprathāsvādodayātmani || 285 ||
kaivalye cātmatā tena bhairaveṇeyataḥ phalam | abhyāsine pradātavyamiyadityevamātmanā || 286 ||
vyavasthayā prakarṣeṇa coditāstadadhīśinā | (....................)eva tadāviṣṭaśarīrādestadātmanaḥ || 287 ||
sthitā anucaratvena purato devatāgaṇāḥ | (.............................)ṣamāveśaikalakṣaṇaḥ || 288 ||
yogo ya eṣa dehāderhṛdaikyāpādanātmanā | samāveśena kālasya grāse saṃkalanātmanaḥ || 289 ||
abhyasyaṃstaṃ vināpyeṣa śaktīnāmuktalakṣaṇam | sāmānyaśakticakreśasvarūpādhyavasātmakam || 290 ||
bhavettadīśatāsiddhiyogyatāṃ labhate ca yat | tathātmatvena tāsāṃ ca cakre'naiti samānatām || 291 ||
yataśca yajane yeyamitikartavyatocyate | tatkriyāpūrakatvena tāmavidvānapi tvayam || 292 ||
jñātena hṛdayenaiva pūraṇātsarvavastunaḥ | vidvānbhavati yaścaiṣa śaṅkāsaṃkocavartinaḥ || 293 ||
vidhīn niyāmakatvena na jānātyātmano'khilān | api tān jñātavāneva yato vidhimanuttaram || 294 ||
cidātmasvavimarśātmahṛdayaikyasvalakṣaṇam | jānāti nanu coktaitatparāmarśātmasātkṛtau || 295 ||
yāgena bhāvyaṃ maivaṃ yattasminnātmanyanuttare | tadyojanaiva yajanaṃ tattāmātro hyanuttaraḥ || 296 ||
ato naye'sminnikhilaṃ vidhānavidhirūpakam | bahiraṅgaṃ bhavatyanyaditi yāgaḥ kriyāmayaḥ || 297 ||
pūrvabhāvitayā cāsya grahaṇe yena coditā | nanu yatpūrvamuktaṃ me hṛdayaṃ bhavatoriti || 298 ||
bījaṃ caturdaśetyādi taduddhāropadeśane | tasyāntastattvaṣaṭtriṃśadrūpaviśvātmatājuṣaḥ || 299 ||
śaktisaṃpūrtirūpāyā parāyāścātmanaściteḥ | vimarśayati sadbhāvamityāśaṃkya nirūpyate || 300 ||
kālāgnimāditaḥ kṛtvā māyāntaṃ brahmadehagam | śivo viśvādyanantāntaḥ paraṃ śaktitrayaṃ matam || 301 ||
tadantarvarti yatkiṃcicchuddhamārge vyavasthitam | aṇurviśuddhamacirādaiśvaraṃ jñānamaśrute || 302 ||
taccodakaḥ śivo jñeyaḥ sarvajñaḥ parameśvaraḥ | sarvago nirmalaḥ svacchastṛptaḥ svāyatanaḥ śuciḥ || 303 ||
yathā nyagrodhabījasthaḥ śaktirūpo mahādrumaḥ | tathā hṛdayabījasthaṃ sarvametaccarācaram || 304 ||
yathā ghaṭaśarāvādivikārānavalokane | gandhatā tadanāmarśe krameṇāhaṃkṛtātmatā || 305 ||
yathā bhūtabhidābhaṅge sukhāditrayarūpatā | vedyavedakatāmātrā tasyāḥ pāryantikī sthitiḥ || 306 ||
tadrūpakañcukāmarśavañcane tasya viśramaḥ | brahmapañcakarūpāyāṃ sattāyāmeva jāyate || 307 ||
sadityasyāpi rūpasya pratyayāṃśāpahastane | bījādyavarṇamātrā syādviśrāntiḥ pāramārthikī || 308 ||
evaṃ jalādimāyāntatattvarūpasya vastunaḥ | sarvasya saiva viśrāntirantyetyatrāntyaviśrame || 309 ||
sarvamekaghanaṃ viśvaṃ tadrūpasyāparicyuteḥ | amṛtībhūtamabhyeti prakṛtiṃ brahmarūpatām || 310 ||
sadeva saumya brahmedamagra ityadhyavasyatām | viśrāntistāvati brahmavādināṃ śrutivedinām || 311 ||
tannirmanthanavṛttyā tu bhairavo viśvasṛṣṭikṛt | gītaṃ ca guruṇā sūnoḥ prathāyāstattvabodhane || 312 ||
mama yonirmahadbrahma tasmin garbhaṃ dadhāmyaham | yadā sato'sya viśrāntidhāmno'pyanavalokanam || 313 ||
tadā prathā vimarśātmaśaktiviśrāmitātmanaḥ | prakāśamānatā siddhirasyetyasya tadekatā || 314 ||
sā ca vāñchākriyājñānaśaktiṣvanyatamā bhavet | sarvaṃ vastu sadicchāmi jānāmityādisaṃvidi || 315 ||
viśramya vyavahārāya niyatāyopakalpate | icchāmītyatra kecchāyāmasti jñānakriyātmatā || 316 ||
prathā saṃrambharūpāyāmevamevānyayorapi | astyevānyonyarūpatvamatastattritayātmani || 317 ||
śaktau triśūlarūpāyāṃ tadviśrāntaṃ prakāśate | tasyāpi tattrayasyaikaṃ svatantraṃ kartṛtattvataḥ || 318 ||
adha ūrdhvodyadindvarkamayabindudvayātmatā | viśvaviśvottarasvātmavyañjanasvaratāmayī || 319 ||
jñeyādyupāyasaṃghātanirapekṣādvayodayāt | jñaptiñca jñātṛtārūpāmahamityāśrayattanum || 320 ||
prakāśamānamevātmarūpaṃ tāttvika iṣyate | tadetadvedyavidvettṛviśrāntitrayalakṣaṇam || 321 ||
bījasya rūpamityuktaṃ bhavatyatra hi viśvatā | saṃpūrṇaśaktirūpatvaṃ svātmabhairavarūpatā || 322 ||
evaṃ hṛdayarūpāyāḥ siddhā āsaṃściterimāḥ | pradhānīkurute tatra yāṃ viśrāntiṃ tadantatā || 323 ||
tadaṃśādhyavasāyatvaprāptānyāṃśadvayodayā | bījoccārasya rūpaṃ syānnatu tattatkalāntatā || 324 ||
bhuktiśca bhuktimukti ca muktiścetyatra siddhayaḥ | svātmabhairavacidrape prakāśe'hamidantayā || 325 ||
icchādiśaktidvāreṇa sataḥ pūrvoktalakṣaṇaḥ | akramakramarūpeṇa kṣepo vaisargikī sthitiḥ || 326 ||
sadrūpametadvedyañca vedakaṃ bhairavātmakam | ubhayasparśanācchaktirūpā cāturdaśī sthitiḥ || 327 ||
avarohakrameṇaiva vettṛvedanarūpataḥ | vedyaviditṛsāmānyarūpatā brahmaṇi sthitiḥ || 328 ||
śāntoditobhayātmaitattryaśraikarasatāmayī | parā visargatā yasya viśrāntitvena sammatā || 329 ||
viśvātmā pūrṇaśaktiśca nātho bhairava eva saḥ | iti kālāgnimityādeḥ sarvametaccarācaram || 330 ||
ityantasyāgamāṃśasya tātparyamavadhāryatām | grantho'tha yojyate pṛthvyāṃ yannivṛttikalātmani || 331 ||
puraṣoḍaśakaṃ proktaṃ kālāgnyādi tathā ca yat | jalādimūlaparyante pratiṣṭhākhyākalātmani || 332 ||
nakulīśādiṣaṭpañcāśatsaṃkhyātmakaṃ puraṃ sthitam | pumādimāyāparyante vidyātmani ca yā sthitā || 333 ||
purāṣṭāviṃśatirvāmapramukhā taiḥ śatātmabhiḥ | bhuvanaiḥ saha pṛthvyādimāyāntaṃ tattvamaṇḍalam || 334 ||
purairhālāhalārambhairaṣṭādaśabhirācite | śāntitatpararūpānyakalādvitayavigrahe || 335 ||
uktasya brahmaṇo dehe tattvapañcakalakṣaṇe | kādihāntaparāmarśarūpaṃ viśrāntimṛcchati || 336 ||
ṣaṭtriṃśattattvarūpasya sato'sya vyañjanātmanaḥ | ādīḥ kartṛjñetṛjñātṛmayo hrasvatrayātmakaḥ || 337 ||
śivaḥ svarātmā yo yā ca tadicchā śaktirūpiṇī | anuttarā parecchā ca parāparatayā sthitā || 338 ||
unmeṣaśaktirjñānākhyā tvapareti nigadyate | ityānandeśanonatvamayadīrghasvarātmikā (?) || 339 ||
śivā śaktitrayamayī syāttad bindvantavedanā | tadetad dvitayaṃ kartṛkriyārūpamanuttare || 340 ||
visargātmani cidrūpe svatantre'nantanāmani | na vidyate'nyaparyāyo yasyāntastatra cātmanaḥ || 341 ||
aśeṣaśaktisaṃghaṭṭaparāmarśamayātmani | turyasandhyarṇarūpāyāṃ citau cānuttareśituḥ || 342 ||
viśrāmyati ya eṣo'sya śabdarāśimahātanoḥ | visargasyāttaviśvasya codakatvena vartate || 343 ||
caturdaśamayaḥ prāṇaḥ śivasyātmatayā śivaḥ | sa eva śuddhavidyādau śivānte tattvapañcake || 344 ||
svavyāpibrahmaṇo dehe sato'vyāpakatāṃ bhajan | jñeyastatrāṃśato vidyāmāyātmātvādyaparvaṇi (?) || 345 ||
bhinnasya bhinnābhinnasya sarvasya jñātṛtāpadam | svamāyāsaṅkaṭottīrṇaṃ prāpnoti parameśitām || 346 ||
pāśairāgantukairmāyāvibhramaiḥ kañcukātmabhiḥ | viyogātsvairasañcāro bhavetsaṃvinmayo'mbare || 347 ||
sahajāṇavavaikalyasiddhisaṃbhāvanāparam | vaimalyamī'svarākhye ca dvitīye yāti parvaṇi || 348 ||
tathā parvaṇi sādākhye tṛtīye vedyalakṣaṇaḥ | idaṃ pratītirūpasya viśvarūpasya vastunaḥ || 349 ||
ācchāditatvātsvaṃ vīryaṃ pratyāhṛtasamastayā | ahamāśāntakallolaścidabdhiḥ svāsthyamaśnute || 350 ||
śaktirūpe tathā svasminnanyasāpekṣatojjhite | svabhānādātmanaḥ pūrṇādaviyoginyanaśvare || 351 ||
ātmanyāyatate tiṣṭhan buddhyate svasya pūrṇatām | tata eva śivākhye'sminnaśuddherbhedalakṣaṇaḥ || 352 ||
sarvātmanā tirodhānācchuciḥ saṃvartako bhavan | karṣānuttarasaṃghaṭṭatryaśrasaṃvinnabho'ntare (?) || 353 ||
svāhājvālāsamālīḍhatattvaugho jvalati svayam | evaṃ codakarūpasya śivasyaivaṃ svarūpataḥ || 354 ||
etadviśrāntiniṣṭho'ṇuruktenābhyāsavartmanā | muhūrtādikrameṇaiva purokte tattvapañcake || 355 ||
śuddhāśuddhādhvarūpe yadvartate dṛkkriyāmayam | svātantryamaiśvaraṃ sarvamaśnute tatparaḥ param || 356 ||
evaṃ muktimayī bhuktiḥ phalatvenāsya kīrtitā | codakābhyāsaniṣṭhasya visargāṃśavyavasthiteḥ || 557 ||
muktirbrahmāṃśaniṣṭhasya bhuktiścaiketi sūcitā | caturthyāṃ paraviśrāntau sarvamekarasātmanā || 558 ||
abhedenaitaduktaṃ tattrayamāste yathā mahān | vṛkṣo nyagrodhadhānāyāṃ taddhānātmasvarūpayā || 559 ||
tacchaktyaivātmanā bhāti tathātra hṛdayātmani | bīje tacchaktibhedena caraṃ śuddhaṃ pramātṛ ca || 360 ||
acarañca tathāśuddhaṃ meyayaṃ ca prathate'khilam | tasmādyat sūcitaṃ pūrvaṃ sadyo yogavimokṣadam || 361 ||
arudrayoginījāto na labhetaitadityataḥ | svātmacidbhairavāveśamātrasiddhiprayojanam || 362 ||
tadetadupasaṃhāradvārā prakaṭamucyate | evaṃ yo veda tattvena tasya nirvāṇagāminī || 363 ||
dīkṣā bhavatyasaṃdigdhā tilādyāhutivarjitā | evamuktena rūpena niḥśaṅkatvena niścitaḥ || 364 ||
yo vetti hṛdayatvena bījametadvikasvaram | tasyāsya paramārthena dīkṣā nirvāṇasatphalā || 365 ||
bhavatyevāstasandehā tathā hyeṣa svasaṃvidā | etaddhṛdayatālābhe tadgatābhistadātmabhiḥ || 366 ||
saṃvidbhirdattamevaitatpūrvaṃ hṛdayalakṣaṇam | jñānaṃ kṣapitamevaivaṃ saṃkocātma ca pāśavam || 367 ||
jānātyeva tato dīkṣā dānakṣapaṇalakṣaṇā | svapratītiprathāsārā saiṣā jñānasvarūpiṇī || 368 ||
ato nātra tilādīnāmupayogaḥ kramātmanām | etāvajjīvato muktimātraniṣṭhitacetasaḥ || 369 ||
etallābhādikaṃ kiṃcinnopayogīti darśitam | adhunā tu samāveśābhyāsārthamupayogavān || 370 ||
pūjāvidhiḥ sa vaktavyo yato vakṣyati śāsanam | kṛtapūjāvidhirbījaṃ smaran syātsiddhibhāgiti || 371 ||
tasmādatra śarīrādau tadabhyāsopadarśanam | kṛtaṃ kariṣyate ceti vidhātuṃ tatra hṛnmatim || 372 ||
prāptaṃ tālamanuktādau nyāsamevāha śāsanam | mūrdhni vakttre ca hṛdaye guhye mūrttau tathaiva ca || 373 ||
nyāsaṃ kṛtvā śikhāṃ baddhvā saptaviṃśatimantritām | ekaikena diśāṃ bandhaṃ daśānāmapi kārayet || 374 ||
tālatrayaṃ purā dattvā saśabdaṃ vighnaśāntaye | puṣpādikaṃ kramātsarvaṃ liṅgaṃ vā sthaṇḍilaṃ cavā || 375 ||
śikhāsaṃkhyābhijaptena toyenābhyukṣayettataḥ | svacaitanyaikatānītajagattritvodayātmakam || 376 ||
vācaḥ parāyā vaktyartharūpāyā hṛdayātmanaḥ | vivakṣādhyavasoktyātmapaśyantyādikramātmanaḥ || 377 ||
parādiśaktirūpeṇa prasarattritvasūcakam | mātṛmānārthasadbhāvavācyāṃśatritayātmakam || 378 ||
hṛdayaṃ bhairavīyaṃ tadātmatvenāvadhārayan | tadaṃśo'ntarupāṃśūccaiḥ śabdanakramalakṣaṇam || 379 ||
śaktyādicaturaṇḍodyatpātālakṣmāntarikṣagān | sarvān śamayituṃ vighān bhedataddhīmayānvibhūn || 380 ||
tālatrayaṃ pārṣṇihastamukhaśabdanamācaran | svīkurvanmātṛmāpīyatrayasadbhāvalakṣaṇam || 381 ||
sṛṣṭiṃ svakīyāmāviśya saṃvidaṃ śaktimāditaḥ | janmacārapravāhākhyalayavicchittilakṣaṇāḥ || 382 ||
dṛśyamānāḥ śarīre'tra svakīye satatoditāḥ | ātmano bhairavīyasya hṛdayāmṛtavārigheḥ || 383 ||
cidānandaiṣaṇājñānakriyākhyāḥ spandasaṃpadaḥ | vimṛśya hṛdaye'traiva sarvatattvamaye nije || 384 ||
bhāti dehatayā kāsyahṛdguhyāṅghriha(?)yātmatā | pañcakṛtvo nyasedbījaṃ teṣu sthāneṣu pañcasu || 385 ||
viśvasattāmayabrahmapañcakasphūrttilakṣmasu | evaṃ hṛdayavidvadbhiḥ samāśleṣāttadātmanaḥ || 386 ||
śikhāvato'sya dehasya yā śikhā saṃviśiṣyate | tadvyāpakatayā dyotattajjvālārūpaṇocite || 387 ||
buddhiprāṇamayātmīyaprakāśaspandanātmatā | tasyāḥ svavyāpitaddehaṣaṭtriṃśattattvarūpatā || 388 ||
tāsāmanyonyabhāvena pratyekaṃ pañcakātmatā | śaktīnāṃ pañcaviṃśatyā proktābhyāṃ ca tadātmanaḥ || 389 ||
dvābhyāmubhayaviśrāntitattvābhyāṃ tattvasaṃpadam | jātayā saptaviṃśatyā bījoccārasvarūpayā || 390 ||
vimṛśya bandhanaṃ kuryāt tattvetyaniyamātmakam | sthūle sūkṣme pare dehe kṛtvaivaṃ hṛdayātmatām || 391 ||
diśo diśāpi hṛdayaparāmarśaikaśeṣatām | nayetsakṛtsakṛdbījaṃ smarannāste kṛtākhilaḥ || 392 ||
athārghyapātraviśrāntaparānandarasasya ca | śikhāsamādhinādhāya hṛdayaikasvarūpatām || 393 ||
takṣaṇābhyukṣaṇadvārā kṛtvedantāṃ vilāpayet | pūjopayogipuṣpaughaṃ tadekarasatāṃ nayet || 394 ||
pūjādhikaraṇaṃ liṅgaṃ svāntādi ca yathoditam | sāmānyato viśeṣācca kṛtvaivaṃ bhedadhilayam || 395 ||
hṛdayaikātmatāṃ nīte tattvādau vedyavistare | ādhārābhimate kvāpi saṃbhavatyatra vastuni || 396 ||
pūjyasvarūpaniṣkarṣapūrvaṃ pūjocyate'dhunā | caturdaśābhijaptena puṣpeṇāsanakalpanā || 397 ||
tatra sṛṣṭiṃ yajeddhiraḥ punarevāsanaṃ tataḥ | sṛṣṭiṃ tu saṃpuṭīkṛtya paścādyajanamācaret || 398 ||
sarvatattvasusaṃpūrṇāṃ sarvāvayavabhūṣitām | yajeddevīṃ maheśānīṃ saptaviṃśatimantritām || 399 ||
tataḥ sugandhipuṣpaiśca yathāśaktyā samarcayet | pūjayetparayā bhaktyā ātmānaṃ ca nivedayet || 400 ||
yaiṣā vispaṣṭatādyātmajāgarādiprathāmayī | pṛthivyādipumantānāṃ tattvānāṃ pañcaviṃśatiḥ || 401 ||
tatsaṃbhāvamayīmādyāṃ kalāṃ hṛdayasaṃvidaḥ | ādyaṃ parvātmatattvākhyaṃ tadunmeṣonatātmakam || 402 ||
tadbhinnābhinnasaṃvittikañcukabrahmavigraham | tattvadvayaṃ śaktiśaṃbhumayaṃ vyāpyāvabhāsinīm || 403 ||
triśūlarūpiṇīṃ vṛttiṃ turīyāmuttaraṃ tathā | parāmṛśyāsanāṃśasya parvataddvayavigrahe || 404 ||
āsane'sminnaśeṣaitatsadrasaikatvacinmayīm | ātmano'nuttarasyātmabhūtāṃ bhairavarūpiṇaḥ || 405 ||
svāntaḥ sthāvyatirekeṇa kṣiptvādikṣāntasṛṣṭikām | visargarūpiṇīṃ vṛttiṃ turyātītātmikāṃ parām || 406 ||
vimṛśya devatāṃ pūjyāṃ visargaṃ bījamuccaran | puṣpeṇa tāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya tasyāṃ tattādṛśātmani || 407 ||
tadāsanāṃśaviśrāntatattvakramaśarīriṇīm | aśeṣāṃ vāṅgamayīṃ sṛṣṭiṃ turyādyābhogaśālinīm || 408 ||
kṣipedyena visargo'yaṃ tanmadhyasthānubhāvataḥ | taduttirṇī tadātmānaṃ sarvakramaśarīriṇīm || 409 ||
sarvairavayavībhūtairbhūṣitāṃ bhāvarāśibhiḥ | svātmīkṛtya svayaṃ bhāti kalā sā tādṛśī parā || 410 ||
tatastādṛśatadrūpasvarūpāmarśarūḍhaye | hṛdayaṅgamatārūpa (-) saurabhyabharitodayaiḥ || 411 ||
svātmārpaṇavaśāttasmiṃstasya rūpasya poṣakaiḥ | puṣpādisadbhāvajātairupacārairyathoditaiḥ || 412 ||
tāṃ devatāṃ tadātmatvacamatkārarasātmanā | pūrṇayā svasya saṃvittyā tatpūrtyādarśarūpayā || 413 ||
snānadhūpāñjanālepatāmbūlāsavamukhyayā | bāhyayā cāpi saṃpattyā pūjayetsamyagātmanaḥ || 414 ||
dehādinā nimagnatvamayaprahṛtyapūrvayā | tatpūjyadevatāsaṃvidutkarṣāmarśarūpayā || 415 ||
tadekarasatāveśaśraddhātiśayatattvayā | bhaktyā bhajanarūpiṇyā parayā pūrṇarūpayā || 416 ||
parā ca yā'sau puṣpāderbhaktiḥ pūjopayoginī | uktaitatsvātmahṛdayahaṭhāveśakriyāpadaḥ || 417 ||
bhāgaḥ parimalādyātmā tacchaktistatsvarūpayā | bhaktyetyuktena rūpeṇa pūjāyāḥ pūrtilakṣaṇaḥ || 418 ||
saṃpūryamāṇamātmānaṃ sarvābhedaghanāṃ citim | saptaviṃśativāroktahṛdayāmarśanakriyaḥ || 419 ||

eṣā pūjoditā tāvadasyāḥ pūrtīhalakṣaṇā | sā bhoktryāḥ saṃvidastasyā bhuktāyāstattvapaddhateḥ || 421 ||
punaḥ prarohaucityātmasaṃskārātmatayā sthitim | ajīrṇeva bhidā janmavyāpiśaṃkodayāvadhim || 422 ||
na bhavedbhasmasādbhāvatadbhogyatvavilāpanam | atītvetyāśayenaināṃ saparyāmupasaṃharan || 423 ||
sūcayatyatidiṣṭena vidhānena hutikriyām | evaṃ yajanamākhyātamagnikārye'pyayaṃ vidhiḥ || 424 ||
hutikriyāyāṃ tatrāpi tadvibhūtārghyavipruṣā | abhyukṣaṇaṃ tilādīnāṃ sruksruvāderhutāśanaḥ || 425 ||
hutāśane ca pūrvoktavartmanāsanakalpanam | bhoktṛsvarūpaniṣkarṣastatrākṣepo jagatsthiteḥ || 426 ||
tadbhuktatattvasaṃskārarūpabhogyavilāpanam | havanena tilādīnāṃ ṣaṭtriṃśattattvatājuṣām || 427 ||
tadekarasatāveśatattvātmā varṇarūpiṇī | pūrṇāhutikriyetyevaṃ tatprakāraḥ pratīyatām || 428 ||
evaṃ yajanahomātmā pūjaiṣā pūrtirūpiṇī | ābhyantaratvasaṃkḷptyā bāhyadravyopasaṃhṛteḥ || 429 ||
nivartitena bhāvena sūtre paścāttu saṃgatiḥ | kṛtapūjāvidhiḥ samyaksmaranbījaṃ prasiddhyati || 430 ||
(......................................)ṣamyak cettena vartmanā | vakṣyamāṇena viśvasya bījaṃ hṛdayamātmanaḥ || 431 ||
smṛtirūpaparāmarśaviṣayatvaṃ samānayan | samyak cāpāstasandehavibhramāvāptilakṣaṇāḥ || 432 ||
prakṛṣṭena prakāreṇa siddhiḥ pūrvoktalakṣaṇāḥ | traikālyadarśanādyāstā bhagavān bhairavo yathā || 433 ||
āptvānenaiva dehena prasiddho bhuvane bhavet | bījātmano vimarśasya bhāto'pyabhinavātmanaḥ || 434 ||
asya pūrvā(rṇā)dirūpeṇa svarūpeṇāvabhāsanāt | apāstakālakalanābhedayogitayodyataḥ || 435 ||
ābhāsanīlarūpasya sarvathābhyantarasya ca | sato'vabhāsanāduktaṃ viśrāntitrayalakṣmaṇaḥ || 436 ||
vastunaḥ smṛtisādṛśyātsmṛtitvenopadeśanam | śatrā ca pratyayenāstavicchedasvāpabhāsanam || 437 ||
parāmṛṣṭāramādevaṃ vande (?) darśayatā śivam | sūcyate'yaṃ parāmarśaḥ tathā svīkriyatāṃ yathā || 438 ||
uktādvicchedarāhityādakālakalitatvataḥ | sakṛdakramarūpeṇa viśeṣeṇātmatātmanā || 439 ||
bhāti svānubhavenaiva pramāṇenāstasaṃśayam | iti nanvidamuktaṃ yat samyak bījaṃ smaranniti || 440 ||
tatsamyaktvaṃ smṛterasyāḥ pūrvaṃ yadyapi darśitam | kālāgnimādītyanena granthena vitatātmanā || 441 ||
tathāpi sphuṭatābhājā rūpeṇāsya vinirṇayam | vidhātuṃ vidhirūpeṇa nirūpayati śāsanam || 442 ||
ādyantarahitaṃ bījaṃ vikasattithimadhyagam | hṛtpadmāntagata dhyāyetsomāṃśuṃ nityamabhyaset || 443 ||
bījaṃ vācakarūpaṃ yadvācyaḥ somāṃśurasya yaḥ | umayā svātmasaṃvittyā viśvottaratadātmanā || 444 ||
ātmanodayamāno'sāvātmā somasya bhātmanaḥ | jñātṛtākartṛtārūpayāmalātmā svatantratā || 445 ||
icchādisaṃvicchaktyaikyamayī saṃghaṭṭarūpatā | pṛthvyādiśivaparyantaṣaṭtriṃśat sphūrtīrūpatā || 446 ||
ityetattritayātmā ca prakāśaḥ sārvakālikaḥ | dvayaṃ tadapi bhedena vācyavācakatātmanā || 447 ||
abhyasedupadeśo yaḥ pāṭhe somāśumityataḥ | somāṃśamiti pāṭhe tu pūrṇaciccandralakṣaṇaḥ || 448 ||
prakāśānandasadbhāvamata eva svabhāvataḥ | jvalanaṃ galanaṃ caiva vṛttiṃ sārayatāśrayan || 449 ||
saṃkucadvikasattvena tena svātantryalakṣmaṇā | pradarśayanpṛthivyādiśivāntāṃ tattvavistṛtim || 450 ||
tadunmeṣanimeṣātmasaṃvicchatatatodayam | tatsaṃpādanasāmarthyasatattvasvapurāmayam || 451 ||
sakāraukārāḥkārātmasvakīyāṃśatrayātmanā | uttarottaramāviṣṭaṃ śaśvat bhāgatrayeṇa ca || 452 ||
anuttaratrikoṇātma yadetaddhṛdayaṃ mahat | somaścāṃśāśca somāṃśamiti sāmastyamānataḥ || 453 ||
samāhārasvarūpeṇa dvandvenāpāditodayam | tadetadābhimukhyena svasaṃvidrūpaviśramam || 454 ||
catuṣkaṃ śūnyadhīprāṇadehātmani catuṣṭaye | catuṣṭayaṃ tūttaratra kṣipet pūrvādito yathā || 455 ||
tathā somāṃśataivātra jaḍatālo(ro)halakṣaṇā | śūnyāditaiva tatrāpi tyaktapārokṣyamīlanā || 456 ||
bhāsate cinmayatvena pratyakṣatvena vāṅmanaḥ | bilamuktaṃ bhavedrūpaṃ visargāṇāṃ caturvidham || 457 ||
tatra somamayaṃ pūrṇamudayavyayavarjitam | sakṛdvibhātaṃ viśvasya bījaṃ tadbhāvataḥ sadā || 458 ||
pītaḥ sa viśvabhāvena viśvasthitividhāyinām | tatsaṃkalanarūpatvasvabhāvātkālatājuṣām || 459 ||
śabdarāśimayasvātmalaharīspandanātmanām | saṃvinmarīcicakrāṇā cakravartitvamāsthitam || 460 ||
samastajñeyaśūnyatvamayasvaprathanātmani | jānāti sātu tanmātre prakāśe pratyagātmani || 461 ||
kṣipedabhedato yena somasyātmatayodayāt | amityapāstapārokṣyaṃ sākṣitvaṃ satataṃ bhavet || 462 ||
some tatrātmanaḥ kṣepāt pratīcastattayodayāt | tyaktasaṃkocamālinyamīlanāviśadātmanaḥ || 463 ||
aśeṣaviśvabharitamacintyānantaśaktikam | akhaṇḍaikarasānandasphuraṇātmakamadvayam || 464 ||
ātmatvamanidaṃtvena bhavet sākṣādanāratam | somasyaivaṃ visargasya pūrṇasaṃvedanātmanaḥ || 465 ||
pūrṇabhairavataivoktā siddhirityuditaṃ bhavet | tadaṃśeṣu yadādyantasvaravyañjanavarjitam || 466 ||
bījaṃ visargarūpatvāt sthitaṃ pūrayatānnijām | śabdanātmatayā svīyasvavimarśātmatājuṣām || 467 ||
svaprakāśāvinābhūtasvayaṃprathanalakṣaṇām | cidādibinduparyantasaṃvedanamayātmanām || 468 ||
svarāṇāṃ tithirūpāṇāṃ vikāsaunmukhyalakṣaṇam | sveśanāsaṃvidantaḥsthaṃ svaśaktyā turyarūpayā || 469 ||
ābhāsitaṃ bahiṣṭvena kādikṣāntākṣarātmakam | pṛthivyādiśivātmāntaviśvamātmatayā śrayat || 470 ||
tadvidyāyāmaśuddhāyāmapūrṇo'smīti saṃvidi | aśeṣābhedakalanāvāgurāsūtraṇātmani || 471 ||
sukhī duḥkhī vimūḍho'smītyevaṃdhīvṛttilakṣmaṇi | hṛdi kṣipdyena so'yaṃ visargaḥ pūrṇacinmayaḥ || 472 ||
tatsāmānyatayā tattvamāptvā sākṣād bhavetsadā | sā ca kṣiptā visarge'smin tadekarasatāṃ gatā || 473 ||
tatpūrṇatāsamāviṣṭā sarvatattvaśarīriṇī | sarvākṣarasamāhārasaṃvidrūpāhamātmikā || 474 ||
jñātṛtākartṛtārūpapramātṛtvātmikā bhavet | visargātmā visargo'yaṃ viśvaṃ vettyahamityataḥ || 475 ||
vedako vittibhedaikyavidhātaivaṃ nirūpitaḥ (?) | somasya veditustasya yā śaktirvāṅmayī parā || 476 ||
vittiryayā vidanviśvaṃ smarannayamapohati | svāntaḥsthitaṃ tadātmānaṃ bhavansaṃvinmayatvataḥ || 477 ||
etadādyantabhūtaitatsadvisargadvayojjhitaḥ | bījaṃ triśūlavṛttyātmaviśvasthitimayātmanā || 478 ||
svaravyañjanarūpāṇāṃ kalānāṃ kalanatvataḥ | codakatvena mādhyasthyarūpaṃ tādātmyamāśrayat || 479 ||
māyāmayasuṣuptyudyadbījātmāhaṅkriyātmani | kalanātmatayā yogakalātattvasvarūpiṇī || 480 ||
samīrātmatayā pañcavṛttispandanalakṣaṇe | prāṇe hṛdyuktivedyena codikeyaṃ tadātmatām (?) || 481 ||
pūrṇasaṃpha(ka)lanātmatvādāptvā sākṣādbhavetsadā | tatra kṣepāttathā prāṇastanmayībhāvayogataḥ || 482 ||
svaspandanamayāśeṣasvaravyañjanavāṅmayaḥ | sarvatattvamayatvena tanmayaṃ dehamāviśan || 483 ||
jñānasmṛtivikalpātmaviśvasaṃvedanātmakam | vedituṃ karaṇaṃ matvā bhavet sākṣādanāśritaḥ || 484 ||
somasya veditustasya svātmano vedanātmanaḥ | tayā karaṇasaṃpattyā saṃpāditajagatsthiteḥ || 485 ||
yaiṣā saṃbandhasāmānyadravyadikkālarūpiṇī | sattātmā kartṛtārūpā kriyāsmītyanapāyinī || 486 ||
sṛṣṭisvarūpiṇī viśvaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśattattvasantatim | śarīrayantī śabdābdhestasya pratyāhṛtakramā || 487 ||
ahamityātmaviśrāntiḥ sā sadodeti sarvadā | tatsvareṇādibhūtena visargeṇāntimena ca || 488 ||
rahitaṃ kevalaṃ bījaṃ sadrūpaṃ tattvalakṣaṇam | ātmanā labdhasattānāṃ tattvānāṃ vedanātmanaḥ || 489 ||
daśāyāḥ śaktirūpāyā avaruhyedamātmanā | saṃvidā vedanīyatvaṃ prāptānāṃ sthitimājuṣām || 490 ||
viśvasya kādikṣāntātmasvaravyañjanatātmanām | mādhyasthyamātmatārūpaṃ codakasvaratāmayam || 491 ||
āśrayaddhṛdaye dehe kṣipedyena tadātmikā | saiṣā kriyā tatsadbhāvarūpā sākṣādbhavetsadā || 492 ||
tatra kṣepeṇa deho'yaṃ tallīnatvena tanmayaḥ | tadbhūtamukhapāṇyaṅghrimadhyadhātusamīracit || 493 ||
anapohyānyabhāvena tasyāhaṃtvena vedyatām | antaḥkṛtākhilārthena bhavet prāptamanāratam || 494 ||
ityevaṃ somatābhājāmaṃśānāmaṃśatājuṣām | somasya ca svarūpeṇa śūnyādīnāṃ catuṣṭayam || 495 ||
svīkurvannātmanā siddharasanyāyena rūpayan | visargeṇa vidhāyaiṣāṃ tanmayatve svavarṇatām || 496 ||
apohya pūrvatadrūpajāpyarūpānyathākṛtām | pūrvoktena pathābhyasyan somāsthānandalakṣaṇam || 497 ||
kālasya grasanaṃ kurvanmuhūrttādikramātmanaḥ | yānyānkāmayate kāmāṃstāṃstāṃcchighramavāpnuyāt || 498 ||
ārabhya mantramudrāṇāmāveśaṃ prāṇadehayoḥ | ṣaṭtriṃśattattvaviṣṭayā ca svātantryāvāptisaṃpadam || 499 ||
avadhīkṛtya pūrvoktāḥ siddhiḥ samyagavāpnuyāt | ahnā pratyakṣatāmeti sarvajñatvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 500 ||
yāvadyāmacatuṣkātmadinaṃ tāvadavasthitiḥ | yadyācarati pūrvoktasomasvādanalakṣaṇam || 501 ||
tadāsya sarvato'vyakte vitate svātmatejasā | māyāsaṃkocarūpāyāṃ niśāyāṃ śamitātmani || 502 ||
prāptāyāmanupākhyatvaṃ svātmacitprasarātmani | turīyatadatītātmadaśādvitayalakṣaṇe || 503 ||
pravṛtte'hani sārvajñyaṃmasandigdhaṃ pravartate | evaṃ matraphalāvāptirityetadrudrayāmalam || 504 ||
eva mantraphalānāṃ yaduktasiddhidvayātmanām | anuttarādito bījāduktādevāptirityataḥ || 505 ||
etattatprathanāyodyacchāsanaṃ rudrayāmalam | sapādakoṭisaṃkhyātaṃ phalasaṃpādakaṃ mahat || 506 ||
etadeva hi bījātma taduktaṃ rudrayāmalam | śivaśaktyostayoratra nityasaṃghaṭṭadarśanam || 507 ||
ata evoktarūpaiddhṛdayābhyāsaśālinaḥ | saṃkṣepataḥ phalaṃ prāha śāsanaṃ śāsituḥ purā || 508 ||
etadabhyasya tatsiddhiḥ sarvajñatvamavāpyate | jijñāsitaṃ vā yatkiṃciccikīrṣitamathāpi vā || 509 ||
yathā tathaiva jānāti karoti tadaśeṣataḥ | ayamasya sthitaivoktā parā bhairavarūpatā || 510 ||
abhyāsena vināpīti pūrṇaṃ śrīśāsanaṃ śivam | eva devena śāsitrā svarūpaṃ yadanuttaram || 511 ||
sadā prakāśamānaṃ sadapi svātantryasaṃpadā | pūrṇayā svasya vicchidya dhāmno yāthātmyalakṣaṇāt || 512 ||
tattacchaṅkātmasaṃkocakāri lokādirūpiṇām | tantrāṇāṃ naitadevaṃ syāttattvametādṛśatvataḥ || 513 ||
tatpravṛttiśca naṣau sāveveṃtvāduditeti ca | bahudhā kathanenaiva gopitātmātra śāsane || 514 ||
svaparāmarśarūpe taddhṛdayatvena bhāsitam | vyākhyākṛto'pi śrīśāstramanuttaramidaṃ tathā || 515 ||
svasmātsthānādapohyaiva paratrākṣiptasūtrakam | tantrātmanā gopitārthabhāṣayāpyākṛtāviha || 516 ||
bhāsitātmīyahṛdayaṃ jātaṃ proktamathātmani | vyākhyātrā śrotṛśikṣārthaṃ vyākhyā tvāgamavastunaḥ || 517 ||
apramoṣātmasātkāravidhitsāsiddhacetasā | vyākhyādau pūrṇarūpāyā viśrānterlakṣitatvataḥ || 518 ||
viśrāntīnāṃ tadaṃśatvāttatsaṃvitsthairyalakṣaṇam | tisṝṇāmadhunā rūpaṃ vakṣyate te svakarmaṇaḥ || 519 ||
he bhoktṛmuditāviśvāḥ (?) santaḥ sādhakapuṅgavāḥ | tyaktvānyakāyacintātmavibhramaiḥ śrūyatāmidam || 520 ||
anuttarasya somasya sattāṃ tattvātmanā tatām | samastasaṃpatsaṃpattiparitṛptiprathāmayīm || 521 ||
samāviśyātmabhāvena tāstāḥ svābhogasaṃpadaḥ | avāpnutāstasandehaviparyastatayoditāḥ || 522 ||
etadvyākhyāvimarśātmavivekamayacetasām | mā bhūdbhramo vaḥ sacchiṣyā hyanyavyākhyāvicāraṇe || 523 ||
etadarthātmasātkāramātra eva hyavāpnuta | svīyasya bhairavatvasya camatkāramayīḥ śriyaḥ || 524 ||
yasyāmanuttarānandau pūrṇatotkarṣaśālinau | yogakṣemātmatāṃ śritvā śrūyate saṃhitodayau || 525 ||
śaktitrayātmikā saiṣā lokasṛṣṭyādikāraṇā | sataḥ somasya saṃvittiḥ saṃpratyayaśarīriṇī || 526 ||
lokyasatkavalīkāre lokayitrātmaviśrame | abhito jā(...)yaṃ dakṣā triśūlatrayarūpiṇīm || 527 ||
trilokīṃ ca tadātmatvamātmīyapratyābhijñayā | svīkurvāṇāṃ cidāhlādapūrṇatāveśapuṣkalā || 528 ||
ahamityātmasātkārarūpāyāṃ kavalīkṛtau | vedyasya sattā satataṃ śobhatāmastaviplavā || 529 ||
ātmanāpūryamāṇaṃ sadātmanā saṃvidoktayā | kṣipantīmātmano'traiva kramākramavibhāgavat || 530 ||
anuttarasya somasya sudatāṃ naumi ṣoḍaśīm | eṣa spandanidhānasya pure citpariṣaṭpateḥ || 531 ||
tenaiva paśvakṛtyātmanāṭyābhinayavedhasā | pumāṃsaṃ puṇyasaṃpūrṇaṃ kamapyāviśatecchayā || 532 ||
idaṃvādinataḥ svasmāt vyākhyāśrītriśikātmanaḥ | śāsanasya svakīyasya svālokādarśarūpiṇaḥ || 533 ||
tathābhinavaguptoktavivṛtivyāpṛtātmanaḥ | tātparyaikaprathātmatvāt nāmnā tātparyadīpikā || 534 ||
seyaṃ prakāśitāśeṣatriśikāśāsanāśayā | savisāsaṃ nabhormadhye sarvamaṅgalayā samam || 535 ||
sadārabdhaṃ tu jagati tvaṭanodyogaśālinaḥ | purataḥ śāśvatīmāptvā sthitiṃ dedīpyate śivam || 536 ||

iti śivam ||
